title: Procurement and installation of Air - Conditioner unit for Inspection quarter (Storm Signal) at Puri Lighthouse, Odisha
summary: GeM bid for supply and installation of two 1.5-ton split air conditioners and two 4 kVA voltage stabilizers for the inspection quarter (Storm Signal) at Puri Lighthouse, Odisha, for the Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Kolkata.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Kolkata

sites.name: Puri Lighthouse, Baliapanda, Puri-752001, Odisha (Inspection quarter, Storm Signal)
sites.work: Supply and installation of split ACs and voltage stabilizers in inspection quarter

scope.item: Split Air Conditioner Including Green AC, Wall Mount Type (V2): 1.5 Ton, non-inverter, 3 star, with G.I. outdoor stand, 10 m drain pipe, 2 rolls wrapping tape; including un-installation of existing AC
Automatic Line Voltage Correctors (Step Type) for Domestic Use - IS 8448, 4 kVA, wall mounting, digital voltmeter

money.notes: Estimated bid value Rs 1,24,570 including GST. GeM bid: EMD not required, ePBG not required; but buyer ATC evaluation table lists EMD (DD/FDR or MSME/NSIC certificate) as compulsory. MSE purchase preference applicable; MII purchase preference not applicable. Payment after satisfactory supply and installation; TDS and GST deducted.

period.warranty: AC: 1 year comprehensive onsite OEM warranty, compressor 5 years or higher; stabilizer: 36 months or higher

eligibility: GeM: minimum average annual turnover Rs 1 lakh (3 years); 3 years past experience; past performance 80% of bid quantity; no MSE/startup exemption

ATC mandatory: OEM authorization certificate; non-blacklisting undertaking/notarised affidavit; bid acceptance form; PAN and GST; product data sheet and technical compliance statement; 5-year residual market life undertaking; no refurbished components; MII certificate on OEM letterhead

ATC technical: one similar work >= 80% of estimated value, or two >= 50%, or three >= 40% in last seven years (7% escalation); similar work defined as supply of air-conditioner related work (ATC Section 1) or electrical installation/wiring (evaluation table)
Average annual turnover minimum 30% of estimate for three years ending March 2025 (CA certified); solvency certificate 40% of estimate; ITR for 3 years; valid electrical licence
Technical evaluation minimum 70/100 (experience 60, turnover 12, solvency 10, ITR 12, PAN 3, GST 3)
specs: Split AC 1.5 ton, cooling only, 3 star (ISEER 3.8-4.39), non-inverter fixed speed, eco-friendly zero-ODP refrigerant, copper condenser coil, 4-way swing, 3 m copper pipe; IS 1391 (Part 2), BEE notification 19 April 2022
ATC Section 2 allows 1.5 ton non-inverter 3 to 5 star
Voltage corrector: 4 kVA, copper winding, digital voltmeter, wall mounting, with time delay; IS 8448
